newsitem.title: FRANCE: France hopes for 25 bln Ffr from Fr Telecom sale.
newsitem.headline: France hopes for 25 bln Ffr from Fr Telecom sale.

text.p: The French Finance Ministry said on Monday it expected to raise 25 billion francs ($4.9 billion) from April's planned partial privatisation of state-owned France Telecom, the country's most profitable company.
"I can confirm to you that the government hopes to raise 25 billion francs from the sale," a spokesman for the ministry said.
He added the sale, expected to be the country's largest privatisation, would likely take place between mid-April and mid-June.
The 25 billion francs, the ministry spokesman said, would largely meet the government's goal of raising 27 billion francs from privatisation receipts next year, he said.
The ministry announced on Friday that Banque Nationale de Paris (BNP) and Banque Paribas had been appointed global coordinators of the float.
The ministry said the sale would include both a public sale as well as a private placement with institutional investors.
The government has pledged to keep a 20 percent holding in the group with a further maximum 10 percent set aside for employees. ($ = 5.084 French Francs)
